sources.label: Sketch LED · 1 × 1 mm, 1,000 lm
sources.note: The app’s default emitter: a 1 mm² Lambertian die at 1,000 lm (≈ 318 cd/mm², brighter than most real LEDs).

sources.label: Generic automotive LED · 2 × 2 mm, 150 cd/mm² (1,885 lm)
sources.note: The default emitter: a 2 × 2 mm Lambertian die at 150 cd/mm² (Φ = π L A = 1,885 lm). About where a well-cooled production automotive or flashlight LED sits under 4500 K without cooking it (Anya, 10-04: ~200 is hot, 300 sustained is a pipe dream).
